name: language-spinner
description: Learn a language while Claude thinks: the spinner shows a phrase in your target language with its translation, from built-in, file or script packs

enabled.title: On
enabled.description: Show phrases in the spinner. Off leaves Claude Code's own spinner words. Also /spinner on|off

pack.title: Pack
pack.description: Where the phrases come from: the built-in japanese, or the name of a pack you added with /spinner add (list them with /spinner packs). Change it with /spinner pack NAME

display.title: Display
display.description: same-line: phrase and translation together. alternate: phrase first, then its translation

intervalSeconds.title: Alternate interval (seconds)
intervalSeconds.description: In alternate display, how long the phrase and then the translation each stay up

rotateSeconds.title: New phrase every (seconds)
rotateSeconds.description: Switch to a different word after this many seconds of the same turn (at least two intervals in alternate display). 0 keeps one phrase per turn

separator.title: Separator
separator.description: What goes between phrase and translation in same-line display
